title: Courtesy Late Fee Waiver — Apartment Home Lease Ledger Posting Card
content:
A courtesy late fee waiver is a goodwill credit that Resident Services may grant against the late fees of one rent month on an Apartment Home Lease. This card states what the waiver is posted against, when it may be granted, and how it is posted.

## Posting rule

- A courtesy waiver is posted as one courtesy late fee waiver credit whose source charge is the initial late fee line of the billing period it covers and whose billing period is that period.
- The period it covers is the most recent late billing period (the billing period of the latest initial late fee line).
- When that initial late fee line already carries a charge reversal credit, the courtesy waiver credit is posted instead against the period's earliest daily late fee line that carries no credit, a charge being waived or reversed at most once.
- Every other condition the credits and waivers rule sets for a courtesy waiver stays in force.

## When it may be granted

A courtesy waiver on a billing period is granted only after the ledger shows a catch-up payment for that period, received on or after its first late day, in the full catch-up amount.

| What the ledger shows for the most recent late billing period | Courtesy waiver on that period |
|---|---|
| A catch-up payment for the period, received on or after its first late day, in the full catch-up amount | may be granted, the other courtesy waiver conditions being met |
| No such payment | not granted |

## Granting the waiver: `grant_courtesy_late_fee_waiver_1c994f24`

**Capability.** The tool records a single credit line coded as a courtesy late fee waiver against the named initial late fee charge, dated today, for the amount given, and lowers the lease's current balance due by that amount. The resident sees the waiver credit on the lease ledger immediately.

**Invocation.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `grant_courtesy_late_fee_waiver_1c994f24` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `lease_id` | The reference number of the apartment home lease whose ledger is credited, read from the lease lookup for the verified resident. | Id |
| `billing_period` | The rent month whose late fees are waived — the same month as the initial late fee charge named in `source_charge_id`. | YYYY-MM |
| `source_charge_id` | The reference number of the initial late fee charge line the waiver credit is posted against, read from the lease charge lookup. | Id |
| `amount` | The waiver amount in USD. | Positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded to the cent before it is passed |

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary with: `status` ("posted" when the waiver credit was recorded); `charge_id` (the reference number of the new credit line); `charge_code` (`late_fee_waiver`); `billing_period` (the month whose late fees were waived, YYYY-MM); `source_charge_id` (the initial late fee charge credited); `amount` (the USD amount waived, 2 decimal places); `new_balance_due` (the lease balance due in USD after the waiver, 2 decimal places).
